relations_to.summary: Exit the FATF grey list (listed 28 Jun 2024) to keep the banking and wealth-management franchise. The June 2026 removal target was missed; reports point to a decision at the October 2026 plenary, not yet taken.

sources.title: FATF may remove Monaco from grey list - report
Monaco Advances in Measured Steps Toward FATF Grey List Removal Following Positive Review

relations_to.summary: FATF adds Monaco (and Venezuela) to the grey list on 28 Jun 2024 for weak action against laundering of overseas-fraud proceeds and too few asset seizures; a June 2025 joint FATF-MONEYVAL review found progress.
